title: Hotel work experience

paragraphs.text: Now turn to section three on page five.
Section three.
You will hear two students called Mona and Tom discussing Mona's recent work experience in a hotel.
First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-one to twenty-six on page five.
Now listen carefully and answer questions twenty-one to twenty-six.
Hi, Tom. I'm exhausted. I've just finished my work experience week at the hotel in the center of town.
Oh, how did it go? Did you do a lot?
Yeah. It was a very good program actually, because they let me work in all the different departments.
Oh, brilliant. So tell me all about it.

Well, first of all, they put me on reception for a morning, and I thought, "Oh, I know what this is all about. It'll just be handing out keys and stuff." How wrong I was. In fact, they handle loads of different things there, special requests, contractors coming in, and so on.
What did you do in the afternoon?

Well, in the afternoon and evening, in fact, I was in the hotel restaurant. There were loads of staff there, so it wasn't too exhausting, but the manager really wanted everything done absolutely precisely, really focused on the guest. You weren't allowed to make any mistakes. I thought it was a bit over the top, actually. Not very enjoyable to work in.
But they've got a really nice coffee bar at that hotel. Did you get a chance to work in that?
Yes, the next morning. You're right, it is nice.
But I bet it gets really busy.

It wasn't too bad, actually. But there's a lot of running around, so I was worn out afterwards. And then I had to go to work in the shop. It's interesting to see how shops fit into the overall hotel culture.
I never know who goes in those hotel shops, but they must be worth it. I suppose they're owned separately from the hotel, though.

Think so. Anyway, there were loads of staff working there, but we still couldn't keep up with the flow of customers because nobody knew where anything was or what they were supposed to be doing. I was quite relieved when it was over.
Then the next day, I went to see what the personal services department did. Fascinating.

Yes. They seem to mop up everything else, don't they? And you must have to be a certain sort of person because to handle the request and some of the people that make them, you have to keep calm and polite, and be quite imaginative to find a way around them and resolve them.
Absolutely. I couldn't do it. It was beyond me. So I just sat and watched and listened.
Didn't you have to go with the domestic staff and do cleaning at all?

Oh, yes, my last day. I was dreading it. I just thought cleaning all those rooms would be so repetitive and tedious. Actually, the girls that do it are really lively and good fun. But by the end of the morning, my ears were ringing. The row of the vacuum cleaners, trolleys going up and down, and the girls shouting at each other. I was amazed the guests didn't complain.
Before you hear the rest of the discussion, you have some time to look at questions twenty-seven to thirty on page six.
Now listen and answer questions twenty-seven to thirty.
So what's your assessment overall?

Um, well, mixed. I mean, my dissertation is on a different topic, and I'm not planning to go into the hotel industry, but I see it as something that we have to do to understand certain aspects of this module that we're on.
Yes. I'd like to do something like that, actually. I think I'll have a word with the tutor to see if he can fix me up with something similar.
The thing is, that'll take a while. I think sometimes people call the hotel directly and see if the manager will take them on. Though, actually, he gets loads of requests, so that might not work.
You might be better to do it directly through the careers office if you've got time to pop down there.
Yes. I might try my tutor first, though.
Well, I've got to go now. I've got to prepare this presentation on my work experience for next week.
Yeah, I guess that's part of the deal that you have to report back.

My tutor doesn't get everyone to do a presentation, so I don't think so. Apparently, he thought my last one was good, so I'm more or less doing a demonstration for the class. Some of them have had very little practice in presenting. By the way, what are you going to do for your assignment this term?

Oh, difficult. I've got that video I did of hotel work, so I think I'll use a bit of that to look at the way that business hotels are developing as conference centers. I really wanted to do something on those big five-star resort hotels, but I haven't got the time.
Oh, well, good luck.
That is the end of section three. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
